0022600193.text: The Orlando Magic (2-6, 0-4 at home, 12th in the East) visit the Golden State Warriors (6-3, winners of six straight, 8th in the West) as both teams are already well into the 2026-27 season, with this being the Magic's 9th game. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and is listed day-to-day with Draymond Green (elbow inflammation), Gary Payton II (calf), and Gui Santos (knee), all three of whom are game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the most recent meeting on December 22, 2025, in San Francisco, where the Magic lost 120-97.
